theorems.name: Submission.dohr_eb_dql_interpolation_fderiv_bound
theorems.statement: ∀ (n ℓ : ℕ) (h : Rn n → Rn ℓ) (x : Rn n) (r t α L S : ℝ), 0 < t → t ≤ r → 0 < α → 0 ≤ L → (∀ y ∈ closedBall x (2 * r), DifferentiableAt ℝ h y) → (∀ y ∈ closedBall x (2 * r), ∀ y' ∈ closedBall x (2 * r), ‖fderiv ℝ h y - fderiv ℝ h y'‖ ≤ L * ‖y - y'‖ ^ α) → (∀ y ∈ closedBall x (2 * r), ‖h y‖ ≤ S) → ∀ y ∈ closedBall x r, ‖fderiv ℝ h y‖ ≤ 2 * S / t + L * t ^ α
